defects.description: Python round() uses banker's rounding (round-half-to-even). Exact ties such as 12.5 / 5.0 = 2.5 round to 2 instead of 3, so R1 half-up tie handling is violated.
Only max_dose_mg is validated as positive. step_mg is never checked, so step_mg <= 0 is accepted and step_mg == 0 raises ZeroDivisionError instead of ValueError.
round_dose never calls audit_log.record_audit and no audit_log import exists in the module. Every call returns without an audit entry.

decoys.why_not_a_defect: Clamp to max_dose_mg after rounding is exactly what R3 requires; it looks like it could be applied in the wrong order but it satisfies R3.
dose_in_grams returns amount_mg / MG_PER_G with MG_PER_G = 1000.0 and no rounding, which is R6. The float division looks suspicious but is correct.
